title: 聊一个小发现
description: 两位成人休息区交流，一人轻示脚尖动作，另一人认真听。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: Two fictional adults discuss a small footwork observation beside a bench outside the landing zone. Keep the scene grounded in conversation, with a towel and bottle nearby and no charts, writing, phones, or dramatic coaching pose.
